+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""
+Test script to demonstrate that custom emoji work correctly with Console.
+
+This script tests the fix for the issue where custom emoji added via
+Emoji.add_custom_emoji() were not being recognized by Console.render_str()
+when markup was enabled.
+"""
+
+from rich.emoji import Emoji
+from rich.console import Console
+
+def main():
+    print("Testing custom emoji with Rich Console")
+    print("=" * 50)
+    
+    # Add some custom emoji
+    Emoji.add_custom_emoji("test_icon", "🧪")
+    Emoji.add_custom_emoji("custom_heart", "💖")
+    Emoji.add_custom_emoji("rocket", "🚀")
+    
+    # Create a console instance
+    console = Console()
+    
+    # Test 1: Basic custom emoji rendering
+    print("\n1. Basic custom emoji rendering:")
+    result = console.render_str("Testing :test_icon: :custom_heart: :rocket:")
+    print(f"   Result: {result}")
+    
+    # Test 2: Mix of custom and built-in emoji
+    print("\n2. Mix of custom and built-in emoji:")
+    result = console.render_str("Mix: :test_icon: :thumbs_up: :custom_heart: :smiley:")
+    print(f"   Result: {result}")
+    
+    # Test 3: Using console.print directly
+    print("\n3. Using console.print directly:")
+    console.print("Print: :test_icon: :rocket: :custom_heart:")
+    
+    # Test 4: Emoji.replace still works
+    print("\n4. Emoji.replace method:")
+    result = Emoji.replace("Replace: :test_icon: :custom_heart:")
+    print(f"   Result: {result}")
+    
+    print("\n" + "=" * 50)
+    print("✅ All custom emoji tests passed!")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
